definitions.short: a Zamzumite , or native tribe of Palestine
definitions.full: H2157. Zamzummim זַמְזֻמִּים proper name, of a people said to be a name given to רְפָאִים by the Ammonites who dispossessed them Deut 2:20 (compare Arabic talk gibberish? ), ᵐ5 Ζοχομμιν , Ζομζομμειν , and Ζομμειν (so ᵐ5 L ); compare Gen 14:5 זוּזִים q. v. ( ᵐ5 ἔθνη ἰσχυρά ).
